arabic: كَانَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ، وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmus-saalihaat. (For displeasing news): Alhamdu lillaahi 'alaa kulli haal.
translation: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) received pleasing news, he would say: 'Praise is to Allah by Whose grace good deeds are completed.' And when he received displeasing news, he would say: 'Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.'
reference: Ibn As-Sunni, Al-Hakim, authenticated by Al-Albani
